## Why (one sentence)

## Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then)
Each criterion must be checkable by a test. No "should be user friendly".

- **AC1** Given ... When ... Then ...
- **AC2** Given ... When ... Then ...
- **AC3** Given ... When ... Then ...

## Definition of ready
- [ ] Every AC is testable
